response.text: My goal is to connect a few of your tools using automation. To make sure I scope this correctly, I have a few questions: What specific tools do you need to connect? What is the desired frequency or trigger for the automation workflows? Different domain, same core work: in Shopify to PostgreSQL inventory sync I used Python, Shopify API, Webhooks, and PostgreSQL to sync stock every 15 minutes, with no oversold orders in the first month.
